details.s: Galadriel was the Ñoldorin Lady of the woods of Lothlórien who witnessed Middle-earth during the three Ages of Awakening.
f: Princess of the Ñoldor, Lady of Lórien, Lady of the Wood, Lady of the Galadhrim, Mistress of Magic
Cate Blanchett, Amelie Child-Villiers, Morfydd Clark, Elena Solovey (Khraniteli)
